name: Hands on Hips Countermovement Jump
instructions: Set up for the Hands on Hips Countermovement Jump with just your bodyweight. Start easy and find your rhythm.
Work at a steady, sustainable pace — you should be able to breathe rhythmically throughout.
Cool down gradually rather than stopping abruptly.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Hands on Hips Countermovement Jump is a intermediate cardio exercise for the quadriceps and calves, performed with just your bodyweight.
